question: The Assam Darrang and Lakhimpur Districts (Assimilation of Laws on State Subjects) (Repealing) Act, 2022, received the Governor's assent in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Wed Feb 01 2023 00:00:00 GMT+0530 (India Standard Time)**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Assam Darrang and Lakhimpur Districts (Assimilation of Laws on State Subjects) (Repealing) Act, 2022** received the Governor's assent on **Wed Feb 01 2023 00:00:00 GMT+0530 (India Standard Time)**.
 
• This act was enacted to repeal outdated laws specific to the Darrang and Lakhimpur districts in Assam.
 
• The purpose of the act is to streamline the legal framework and ensure uniformity in the application of state laws across these districts.
 
• Such repealing acts are part of ongoing efforts to update and rationalize the legal system in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Assam** is a state in northeastern India, known for its rich culture, diverse population, and significant contributions to the country's tea production.
 
• The state government has been actively working on legal reforms to ensure that the laws are up-to-date and relevant to the current socio-economic conditions.
 
• Repealing outdated laws helps in reducing legal ambiguities and enhances the efficiency of the legal system.
 
• The process of repealing and updating laws is crucial for maintaining a robust and responsive legal framework in any state.
